definitions.explanation: A newspaper, magazine, or other publication that is issued every day. Often used as a prefix in newspaper names.

examples.japanese: {日刊|にっかん}{紙|し}を{読|よ}んでいる。
このニュースサイトは{日刊|にっかん}で{更新|こうしん}される。
examples.english: This news site is updated daily.

examples.japanese: {日刊|にっかん}スポーツは{日本|にほん}の{有名|ゆうめい}なスポーツ{新聞|しんぶん}だ。
examples.english: Nikkan Sports is a well-known Japanese sports newspaper.

notes:
Used as a modifier or prefix indicating daily frequency of publication. Very common in newspaper names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日刊|にっかん}{紙|し}: daily newspaper
- {日刊|にっかん}{新聞|しんぶん}: daily newspaper
- {日刊|にっかん}スポーツ: Nikkan Sports (newspaper name)

RELATED WORDS:
- {週刊|しゅうかん}: weekly publication
- {月刊|げっかん}: monthly publication
- {朝刊|ちょうかん}: morning edition
- {夕刊|ゆうかん}: evening edition

ETYMOLOGY:
Combines {日|にち} (day) and {刊|かん} (publish/edition). The same {刊|かん} appears in {週刊|しゅうかん} and {月刊|げっかん}.
